Metabase.METABASE_ADMIN_EMAIL: Email for the administrator created on first boot.
Metabase.METABASE_ADMIN_PASSWORD: Generated first-boot administrator password; changing it later does not rotate the account.
Metabase.MB_ENCRYPTION_SECRET_KEY: Generated key used to encrypt warehouse credentials in Metabase.
Metabase.JAVA_OPTS: Bounded Java heap sized for this small-team baseline.

dbt.DBT_RUN_INTERVAL_SECONDS: Seconds between successful dbt seed and build runs.
